text_block_list.text:
Here in a foreign land far from Tracen 
Academy—I came for a short-term overseas 
inspection, but...

I studied the basics in textbooks, but 
applying them in real conversation was 
surprisingly difficult. During debates,
it 
was especially noticeable.

text_block_list.text: —Hello, bonjour? Oh yeah~s♪

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Je, Seeking The Store!
Seeking The Gold on 
this Earth!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Store, is, where could it beee~~??

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Really?! Very, very, je t'aime~♪

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, aren't you a Tracen Academy 
Trainer? What a coincidence to meet in a 
place like this♪

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Ça va?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
—Oh, you leaped out into the world to
gain 
a global perspective♪ Not bad at all!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: —*This!*
choice_data_list: The road ahead looks rough, but......
The road ahead looks rough, but......

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
The limited edition of *This Earth*! I 
came all the way to buy the sparkling
Gold 
Version♪

*This Earth*—a globe she pulls out from 
time to time, and lately I've seen other 
students holding them too, but...
choice_data_list: First of all... what even is *This...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Hmm? *This Earth* is *This Earth*, of 
course?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Ah, you want to hear the story behind it? 
We have plenty of time, so why not. I'll 
share a tale from my past♪

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Yes, that was the day before my young
self 
took off to explore the world with my 
parents—

text_block_list.name: Young Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Pappy, Pappy! What's this? It's blue, 
sparkly, and so very beauty!

text_block_list.name: Pearl's Father
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my little Pearl! This, you see, is 
future possibilities.

text_block_list.name: Pearl's Father
text_block_list.text:
Starting tomorrow,
we'll travel all around 
the world. You will get to see many, many 
different things.

text_block_list.name: Pearl's Father
text_block_list.text:
The fun things, the tough things. 
*Everything, from soup to nuts.*

text_block_list.name: Pearl's Father
text_block_list.text:
*This*—the Earth.
Everything you encounter 
on it will connect to your dreams and
your 
future. Keep that firmly in mind.

text_block_list.name: Young Pearl
text_block_list.text: *This*... Earth...!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
And so, alongside *This Earth* gifted to 
me by Pappy, I traveled the world.

text_block_list.name: Young Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Languages I don't know, buildings I've 
never seen... Ooh...

text_block_list.name: Young Pearl
text_block_list.text:
...*Non!* I have to muster up my courage, 
right, *This Earth*!

text_block_list.name: Young Pearl
text_block_list.text:
If everything I encounter connects to my 
dreams and future—
I want to experience so 
much more of the world...!!

text_block_list.name: Young Pearl
text_block_list.text:
*Wow*, is this a Giant Puffball?! What a 
huge mushroom... Huh, you can eat it?!

text_block_list.name: Young Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Amazing,
amazing! Is this what world-class 
races look like...?! Hey,
*This Earth*...! 
Someday, I will too—

text_block_list.name: Young Pearl
text_block_list.text:
*This Earth*... The world isn't just full 
of pretty things. There are people 
suffering, people who can't afford to 
dream.

text_block_list.name: Young Pearl
text_block_list.text:
—So that those people can dream too, I 
want to become a pearl that illuminates 
the world with racing and blows away 
despair!!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
—Traveling the world helped me find my 
dream.
And I was able to find it because I 
had *This Earth* with me.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Yes. *This Earth* will stay by my side in 
the future as well.
Continuing to grant me 
courage, just as it always has—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: And it shall do the same for you.

What she handed to me was a 
miniature-sized *This Earth*.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Right now,
you're experiencing a new world 
and feeling a bit overwhelmed, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
However, once you overcome that,
wonderful 
encounters and unknown possibilities will 
be waiting for you.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Muster your courage. As long as you have 
passion, your heart will reach others no 
matter where you are in the world!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: —Let me ask you once more. Ça va?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
*Good!* Nice gestures too! Looks like 
you'll be just fine now♪

Saying, "Gold This Earth is waiting for 
me!", Seeking the Pearl dashed off 
gallantly. Watching her leave, a thought 
crossed my mind.

The mystery remained unsolved, but I felt 
ready to tackle the rest of my
observation 
tour with a positive mindset.
